verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own export of raw, unaggregated transactional event data, but only for the past 7 days. Nothing in the pack shows a full-account export of contacts, campaigns, templates, CRM or automations, or names the export formats. Missing for 10: full-account data export covering contacts, campaigns, templates, CRM and automation data; documented open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON); event history beyond 7 days; account-closure/offboarding documentation; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export raw data of all transactional events from the past 7 days. Generate reports with unaggregated data for analytics.
